snippet.title: Rita - Official Trailer - OUT NOW
snippet.description:
🔴 OUT NOW on Steam 🔴

Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

🐤 GET IT on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984850/Rita
🐣 TRY the Demo first: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837060/Rita_Demo

Love cozy puzzle games? Like, comment, and subscribe for more details on Rita! #CozyGames #PuzzleGames #IndieGames #WordPuzzles #Gaming
